questions.stem: What kind of place does Grandma live in?
questions.listenScript: Grandma knows the little shops near her home. She walks along a few short streets to buy food, while the nearest city is an hour away.

listenLines.text: Grandma knows the little shops near her home. She walks along a few short streets to buy food, while the nearest city is an hour away.

questions.explanation: A town is a place with homes and shops, usually smaller than a city.
questions.parentExplanation: 住宅、商店以及小于城市的范围共同限定town。

translation.stem: 奶奶住在什么样的地方？
translation.listenScript: 奶奶熟悉家附近的小商店。她沿着几条短街走去买食物，而最近的城市距这里有一小时路程。

questions.stem: Which word names the special part of the place?
questions.listenScript: People often mention the old red bridge when they describe this place. Visitors take photos of it because its shape is different from the bridges nearby.

listenLines.text: People often mention the old red bridge when they describe this place. Visitors take photos of it because its shape is different from the bridges nearby.

questions.explanation: A feature is a special part or quality of a place.
questions.parentExplanation: 这里考查feature的特色、特征义项，不是脚印、日记或活动。

translation.stem: 哪个词指这个地方的特色？
translation.listenScript: 人们介绍这个地方时，经常提到古老的红桥。游客给它拍照，因为它的形状与附近的桥不同。

questions.stem:
North is at the top of this map. The south is at the bottom.
What does “south” mean here?

translation.stem: 这张地图上方是北方。下方是南方。 这里“south”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “south” means “the direction opposite north”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“south”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“the direction opposite north”。对应源表释义为“南；南方”。

There are no clouds today. The sky is clear.
What does “clear” mean here?

translation.stem: 今天没有云。天空晴朗。 这里“clear”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “clear” means “having no clouds”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“clear”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“having no clouds”。对应源表释义为“晴朗的”。

questions.stem:
Do you mind if I open the window, or would the cold air bother you?
What does “mind” mean here?

questions.explanation: Here, “mind” means “to feel annoyed by something or object to it”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“mind”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to feel annoyed by something or object to it”。对应源表释义为“介意”。

questions.stem:
This coat is just the right size for me: neither too big nor too small.
What does “just” mean here?

translation.stem: 这件外套的尺码恰好适合我：既不太大也不太小。 这里“just”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “just” means “exactly”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“just”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“exactly”。对应源表释义为“恰好”。

questions.stem: We walk along a s________ path with sand under our feet.
questions.explanation: Sandy is an adjective describing the path.
questions.parentExplanation: 名词path前用形容词sandy，表示含沙或铺满沙子的。

translation.stem: 我们沿着一条铺满沙子的小路走，脚下都是沙。

questions.stem: Can you k________ the ball to me with your foot?
questions.explanation: Use the base form kick after can.
questions.parentExplanation: 情态动词can后用动词原形kick。

translation.stem: 你能用脚把球踢给我吗？

questions.stem: There are two small t________ near this city.
questions.hint: places with streets, homes and shops
questions.explanation: Two needs the plural noun towns.
questions.parentExplanation: two后必须用复数towns。

translation.stem: 这座城市附近有两个小镇。（有街道、房屋和商店的地方）

questions.stem: The red bridge is an important f________ of this town.
questions.explanation: Use a singular noun after “an important”: “feature”. The phrase “a special part” gives its meaning.
questions.parentExplanation: 空格前有an important，应填单数可数名词feature；提示中的a special part说明此处考查“特色”义项。

translation.stem: 红桥是这个镇的一个重要特色。（特别的部分）

questions.stem: We drive from the north of the country to the s________, the opposite end.
questions.hint: the direction or region opposite north
questions.explanation: South names the direction or region opposite north; here it is a noun after the.
questions.parentExplanation: south指与北方相对的南方；the后用方位名词，保持源词性为名词。

translation.stem: 我们从这个国家的北部开车去南部，也就是相对的一端。

questions.stem: There is not a cloud in the c________ sky.
questions.explanation: A clear sky has no clouds.
questions.parentExplanation: clear在此为形容词，表示晴朗的，与没有云相符。

translation.stem: 晴朗的天空中没有一朵云。

questions.stem: The art club helps me d________ my drawing skills through regular practice.
questions.hint: Use a verb meaning make an ability grow and become better.
questions.explanation: Skills grow and improve when we develop them.
questions.parentExplanation: 培养、发展技能用develop；help me后可接动词原形。

translation.stem: 美术社团通过定期练习帮助我发展绘画技能。

questions.stem: I cannot s________ this maths problem yet, so I ask the teacher to explain it.
questions.hint: Use a verb meaning find the answer to a problem.
questions.explanation: Finding a problem's answer is solving it; after cannot use solve.
questions.parentExplanation: 解答问题用solve，cannot后接动词原形。

translation.stem: 我还解不出这道数学题，所以请老师讲解。

passages.text: Our school sports afternoon is next Wednesday, and Kai is excited about it. He tells his friend, “I look forward to running with our team.” His friend Lily wants to take part in the race too, although she does not run very fast. They meet after school to practise, and Kai waits when Lily needs a rest. Their teacher says that helping a teammate is as important as finishing the race. Now both friends feel ready to enjoy the afternoon together, whatever place they finish in.

parallelText.en: Our school sports afternoon is next Wednesday, and Kai is excited about it.
parallelText.zh: 我们学校下周三举办体育活动下午场，凯对此很兴奋。

parallelText.en: He tells his friend, “I look forward to running with our team.”
parallelText.zh: 他告诉朋友：“我期待和队伍一起跑步。”

parallelText.en: His friend Lily wants to take part in the race too, although she does not run very fast.
parallelText.zh: 他的朋友莉莉也想参加比赛，虽然她跑得不很快。

parallelText.en: They meet after school to practise, and Kai waits when Lily needs a rest.
parallelText.zh: 他们放学后见面练习，莉莉需要休息时，凯会等她。

parallelText.en: Their teacher says that helping a teammate is as important as finishing the race.
parallelText.zh: 老师说，帮助队友和完成比赛一样重要。

parallelText.en: Now both friends feel ready to enjoy the afternoon together, whatever place they finish in.
parallelText.zh: 现在两位朋友都准备好一起享受这个下午，无论最后取得什么名次。

wordHelp.meaning: a competition to see who is fastest
a person on the same team

passages.text: The reading club plans a book sale to help buy books for younger pupils. At first, only a few people stop at the table, so the club puts up a big sign. Soon more families come, and all the books find new readers by the afternoon. The sale is a success because the club can buy the books it planned to buy. The members celebrate by sharing fruit and thanking everyone who helped. They are pleased because their work helps other children enjoy reading.

parallelText.en: The reading club plans a book sale to help buy books for younger pupils.
parallelText.zh: 阅读俱乐部计划义卖书籍，帮助为低年级学生买书。

parallelText.en: At first, only a few people stop at the table, so the club puts up a big sign.
parallelText.zh: 起初，只有几个人停在桌边，于是俱乐部竖起了一块大标牌。

parallelText.en: Soon more families come, and all the books find new readers by the afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 不久，更多家庭来了，到下午，所有的书都找到了新读者。

parallelText.en: The sale is a success because the club can buy the books it planned to buy.
parallelText.zh: 义卖成功了，因为俱乐部可以买到原计划购买的书。

parallelText.en: The members celebrate by sharing fruit and thanking everyone who helped.
parallelText.zh: 成员们一起吃水果，向所有帮忙的人致谢，以此庆祝。

parallelText.en: They are pleased because their work helps other children enjoy reading.
parallelText.zh: 他们很高兴，因为自己的努力帮助其他孩子享受阅读。
